title: Record activity rows title a record by its raw lookup id when the object's nameField is a lookup ("Created Project Member \"gCX6SR…\"")
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAjSbVCwcyoaiYadYJW

Filing gate **① a reproduced defect** (user-visible), measured from HotCRM 6.4.0 on platform **18.5.0** during the end-to-end customer test.

## What happens

`crm_project_member` declares `nameField: 'person'`, a lookup to `sys_user` (hotcrm `src/psa/objects/project_member.object.ts:24`). The console resolves it correctly in the record header: the record page H1 reads **Chris Consultant**. Every activity row about the same record, on its own page, on the parent project and in the home Activity feed, prints the stored foreign key instead:

| Surface | Shows |
|---|---|
| Record page header (`/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm.psa/crm_project_member/record/NtAM2vJYa1Iae8OP`) | Chris Consultant |
| Same page, Activity: create row | 创建了 项目成员 "gCX6SRAtjmbpOPbxbcit1JxebXaHdAch" |
| Same page, Activity: update row | 更新了 项目成员 "gCX6SRAtjmbpOPbxbcit1JxebXaHdAch"：费率卡 |
| Home → Activity feed (project manager) | Pablo PM 创建了 项目成员 "ZqLE6ESvrvQf3EZ4VW7ewDFi2VdrXigU" |

Reach: the console, measured once (zh-CN; en reads the same id). Reproduce on any app object whose `nameField` is a lookup: create a row, then open its Activity.

## Seam

The activity/audit record label resolves the nameField's stored value without following the lookup to the target's display name. #21878 (closed) moved `recordLabel` to the ADR-0079 resolver; that resolver appears to stop at the stored column. #33107 (closed) fixed the same class for analytics dimension labels; #30454 and #26195 (closed) fixed it per system object.

## Suggestion

Resolve a lookup `nameField` to the target record's own title when the label is written (or rendered), as the record header already does. If a lookup `nameField` is not meant to be supported, the alternative is to refuse it at publish (`os lint` / schema). Then the record header's resolution is the unintended half, and apps get a loud error instead of ids in their feed.

## Business reason

Every PSA tenant sees the staffing feed, which is the first thing a project manager reads after staffing a project, as rows of 32-character ids. Any app that titles a join object by its person (memberships, assignments, attendees) hits the same thing.

**Reader:** the objectstack server lane (plugin-audit / record label), or spec if the decision is to refuse lookup nameFields.

**Grade suggestion: `priority:p2`**: user-visible on a shipped surface, reproducible, no data loss. **Size: S.**

**Dedupe:** `gh api search/issues` on `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue activity nameField lookup` (15 hits) and `"nameField" lookup raw id` (15 hits, overlapping). All are closed and none covers a lookup-typed nameField in activity rows: #21878, #33107, #30454, #26195, #20015 and #20059 are the nearest.
